about: Pure-Ergo gocmd flag merging, vendor pattern matching, and one-language-per-package guards.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-gocmd-gcflags-accumulate
mutants.rule: Per-package -gcflags must take the last matching flag set whole rather than accumulating earlier matches.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-gocmd-vendor-matched
mutants.rule: Wildcard ... patterns must never cross a vendor path segment boundary.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-gocmd-mixed-allowed
mutants.rule: An Ergo package directory must refuse same-package Go files while permitting external _test packages.
